final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_qty FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY order_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as overall_avg FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL) SELECT step1.order_id, step1.avg_qty, step1.avg_qty - step2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
